name: gitlab-ci-visualizer
description: Preview and analyze GitLab CI pipelines interactively

gitlab-ci-visualizer.gitlabUrl.description: Base URL of your GitLab instance.

scripts.build-web: cd ../web && npm run build && rm -rf ../vscode/media && cp -r dist ../vscode/media
scripts.build-go: cd .. && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o vscode/bin/gitlab-ci-analyzer-linux-amd64 . && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -o vscode/bin/gitlab-ci-analyzer-linux-arm64 . && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -o vscode/bin/gitlab-ci-analyzer-darwin-arm64 . && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -o vscode/bin/gitlab-ci-analyzer-darwin-amd64 . && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -o vscode/bin/gitlab-ci-analyzer-windows-amd64.exe .
scripts.build: npm run build-web && npm run build-go && npm run compile
